dct_creator_sm: Catchment and Wetland Sciences Research Group, University of Alberta.
dct_description_sm: Our project examined water quality in two catchments in the Dehcho of the Northwest Territories through a partnership between University of Alberta researchers and the Dehcho Aboriginal Aquatic Resources and Oceans Management program. Over three years (2019-2021), we sampled methylmercury, mercury, dissolved organic matter, nutrients, and ions at Smith Creek and Scotty Creek.
dct_title_s: Seasonal Monitoring of Smith Creek and Scotty Creek, 2019-2021
